transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. I wanted to get us together to talk through the press release package for the surprise partner-studio premiere we're planning to issue next week. The current draft is in decent shape — it names the film, uses a production still, displays our presenting-sponsor lockup, and links to a short promotional video. Before I approve anything, I want to make sure we've completed the standard final review across legal, publicity, partnerships, and accessibility. Has each of those teams had a chance to sign off yet?

transcript.text: I need to flag something on the legal side.
